retrieval_sessions.evidence_boundary: Bounded web capture retained from the first integration pass; it is not an exhaustive search receipt.
Direct arXiv abstract pages were opened and inspected on 2026-07-21. Retrieval establishes page metadata and author-stated claims only, not correctness, peer validation, or completeness.

coverage_limits: This is a targeted, non-exhaustive capture; no systematic review, citation-graph closure, or all-database search was performed.
The targeted repair inspected arXiv abstract pages, not every full proof or cited supporting paper.
Journal references shown by arXiv are bibliographic metadata and do not independently validate a theorem claim.
The cutoff certifies only what was retrieved by the named providers and queries on 2026-07-21.
Absence from this snapshot is not evidence of novelty or nonexistence.
inclusion_policy: Include current direct target challengers, primary genealogy for each live conceptual lane, authoritative target status, calibrated related models, and explicit negative controls. Preserve exact domain and transfer boundaries; require source-to-theory effects rather than bibliography-only mention.
epistemic_boundary: Provider retrieval is evidence that the named page and metadata were inspected. No retrieved research claim is promoted to an accepted Clay solution, verified theorem, exhaustive literature conclusion, or peer-validation judgment.

sources.title: Yang-Mills & the Mass Gap
sources.domain: official problem statement and prize-status boundary
sources.transfer_boundary: Authoritative for target/status framing; it does not assess any particular Abducer route or independently referee a recent paper.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Keep every imported and generated route below solved-target status; no local artifact may override the official acceptance boundary.
reported_claims: The Yang-Mills existence and mass-gap problem remains presented as an open Millennium Prize problem.

sources.title: Reflection-Positive Construction of a Four-Dimensional SU(N) Yang-Mills Theory with Mass Gap and Confinement
sources.journal_metadata: Fortschr. Phys. 74 (2026) 4, e70097, as reported on arXiv
sources.domain: claimed pure four-dimensional SU(N) construction, reflection positivity, continuum limit, mass gap, and confinement
sources.transfer_boundary: This record captures the authors' abstract-level claims. Neither arXiv presence nor journal metadata verifies the construction, closes its proof obligations, changes Clay status, or establishes that Abducer may treat the target as solved.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Create an immediate claim-collision audit for all reflection-positive, multiscale, OS-reconstruction, universality, and Hamiltonian-gap routes. Reprioritize comparison; do not promote or retire any theory until the claims are independently checked.

claim_audit.author_stated_claim: A reflection-positive lattice formulation yields a transfer operator with a uniform gap.
claim_audit.required_obligation: Locate the exact theorem, hypotheses, gauge constraints, volume/coupling regime, and proof of uniformity; rule out assuming the desired gap in the starting formulation.

claim_audit.author_stated_claim: Convergent character or polymer expansions establish an area law for large Wilson loops.
claim_audit.required_obligation: Check convergence domains, uniform constants, loop class, coupling regime, and whether the result reaches the continuum/asymptotically-free trajectory rather than a restricted strong-coupling model.

claim_audit.author_stated_claim: Finite-range gauge-covariant multiscale estimates carry exponential clustering and positive string tension to the continuum.
claim_audit.required_obligation: Audit every scale-uniform estimate, regulator removal, tightness/existence step, defect summability bound, and theory-identity argument without importing the conclusion.

claim_audit.author_stated_claim: Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction produces a Minkowski theory with a self-adjoint Hamiltonian and positive spectral gap.
claim_audit.required_obligation: Verify the full OS axiom package, continuum Schwinger-function construction, vacuum sector, observable density, and the exact implication from Euclidean decay to a nonzero physical Hamiltonian gap.

claim_audit.author_stated_claim: Lipschitz control and telescoping identify all admissible reflection-positive slicings with one regulator-independent limiting measure.
claim_audit.required_obligation: Define the admissible regulator class, check uniform comparison bounds and uniqueness, and establish that the limiting measure is the required pure Yang-Mills theory rather than a restricted construction.

claim_audit.author_stated_claim: The strong-coupling continuum construction and an asymptotically free weak-coupling trajectory meet in the same theory.
claim_audit.required_obligation: Audit the weak-coupling entry theorem, asymptotic-freedom control, overlap/continuation argument, absence of phase-boundary assumptions, and equality of observables across the two constructions.

reported_claims: The authors claim a reflection-positive pure four-dimensional SU(N) construction with continuum existence, a mass gap, and confinement; every component remains unverified here.

sources.title: Uniqueness of gauge covariant renormalisation of stochastic 3D Yang-Mills-Higgs
sources.domain: uniqueness of mass renormalisation yielding gauge-covariant local solutions for stochastic 3D Yang-Mills-Higgs
sources.transfer_boundary: Three-dimensional Yang-Mills-Higgs stochastic dynamics and renormalisation uniqueness do not establish global existence, invariant pure-4D Yang-Mills measure, stochastic hypocoercivity, physical-time decay, OS reconstruction, or a mass gap.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Strengthen the stochastic lane's gauge-covariant renormalisation obligation and lattice-approximation interface while splitting those results sharply from its proposed relaxation-to-physical-spectrum bridge.
reported_claims: The paper proves uniqueness of the mass renormalisation leading to gauge-covariant local stochastic 3D Yang-Mills-Higgs solutions.

sources.title: Stochastic quantisation of Yang-Mills-Higgs in 3D
sources.domain: local stochastic 3D Yang-Mills-Higgs flow, nonlinear distributional state space, gauge-orbit quotient, and canonical Markov process up to possible blow-up
sources.transfer_boundary: The result is lower-dimensional, includes Higgs fields, is local in time, and permits finite-time blow-up; it does not yield a pure-4D invariant measure, uniform relaxation rate, or physical Hamiltonian spectrum.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Replace generic process rhetoric with a concrete gauge-orbit state-space comparator and make globality, dimension/model transfer, uniform mixing, and stochastic-to-physical generator separation explicit obligations.
reported_claims: The paper constructs local renormalised stochastic 3D Yang-Mills-Higgs flow and a canonical Markov process on a gauge-orbit quotient, up to possible finite-time blow-up.

sources.title: Langevin dynamic for the 2D Yang-Mills measure
sources.domain: two-dimensional stochastic Yang-Mills heat flow, distributional connections, Wilson loops, and Polish gauge-orbit state space
sources.transfer_boundary: Two-dimensional Yang-Mills is not the four-dimensional pure target; well-defined Langevin dynamics and orbit topology do not imply cutoff-uniform hypocoercivity or a physical mass gap.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Supply rigorous process/orbit-space genealogy while forcing the process-first and metric lanes to state the missing 2D-to-4D, stochastic-to-physical, and concentration-to-spectrum transfers.
reported_claims: The paper constructs a natural state space and Markov process for the two-dimensional stochastic Yang-Mills heat flow.

sources.title: Generalized Global Symmetries
sources.domain: q-form symmetries, extended charged operators, Ward identities, gauging, spontaneous breaking, and anomalies
sources.transfer_boundary: Generalized-symmetry and anomaly data classify and constrain phases but do not by themselves construct pure 4D Yang-Mills or set a positive quantitative excitation scale.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Ground the higher-form and loop/surface lanes in the established symmetry language, while requiring a new noncircular quantitative axiom before any mass-scale inference.
reported_claims: The paper develops q-form global symmetries, their extended charged operators, Ward identities, spontaneous breaking, and anomaly constraints.

sources.title: Theta, Time Reversal, and Temperature
sources.domain: mixed time-reversal/center-symmetry anomaly and vacuum constraints for SU(N) gauge theory at theta equals pi
sources.transfer_boundary: The theta=pi anomaly constrains possible vacua and phases; it is not a construction or mass-gap proof at theta=0, and an abstract statement that theta=0 is gapped cannot be imported as proof of the Clay target.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Split qualitative sector constraints from quantitative gap generation and require the higher-form lane to identify exactly which theta, symmetry, and vacuum assumptions it uses.
reported_claims: The paper identifies a mixed time-reversal and center-symmetry anomaly at theta equals pi and derives constraints on possible vacua.

sources.title: Linear Yang-Mills theory as a homotopy AQFT
sources.domain: homotopy AQFT for linear Yang-Mills, functorial differential graded observable algebras, and BRST/BV field content
sources.transfer_boundary: The construction is linear on globally hyperbolic Lorentzian spacetimes; it supplies categorical observable structure but not interacting pure Yang-Mills existence, nonperturbative local nets, nuclearity, or a mass gap.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Give the operator-algebra and observable-reconstruction lanes a precise categorical comparator while adding an explicit nonlinear-interacting construction barrier.
reported_claims: The paper constructs a homotopy AQFT for linear Yang-Mills with functorial differential graded observable algebras reproducing BRST/BV field content.

sources.title: Quantum conditional mutual information and approximate Markov chains
sources.domain: finite-system quantum conditional mutual information and approximate recovery/Markov structure
sources.transfer_boundary: This is a general quantum-information theorem, not Yang-Mills evidence; applying it requires a physically defined algebra/state factorization, gauge constraints, continuum control, and a separate implication to spectral observability.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Ground recovery language in an actual theorem but demote any direct Yang-Mills inference until the observable algebra, gauge quotient, continuum limit, and recovery-to-gap bridge are proved.
reported_claims: The paper bounds approximate quantum Markov recoverability using quantum conditional mutual information in finite tripartite systems.

sources.title: The scaling limit of SU(2) lattice Yang-Mills-Higgs theory
sources.domain: massive Gaussian scaling limit for an SU(2) lattice Yang-Mills-Higgs regime
sources.transfer_boundary: The Higgs field, Gaussian limit, and parameter regime are not the non-Gaussian pure four-dimensional Yang-Mills target.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Retain as a rigorous massive comparator while forbidding transfer to pure Yang-Mills, regulator removal, or a Hamiltonian gap.
reported_claims: The paper constructs a massive Gaussian scaling limit for a specified SU(2) lattice Yang-Mills-Higgs regime and leaves the non-Gaussian scaling limit open.

sources.title: Yang-Mills mass gap: a geometric approach
sources.domain: geometric approach to Yang-Mills mass-gap questions
sources.transfer_boundary: Geometric motivation or conditional steps do not discharge the normalized nonlinear kernel, continuum, OS, universality, or physical-spectrum gates used here.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Compare geometric and metric language directly before claiming novelty, while retaining every unproved transfer as an open obligation.
reported_claims: The article proposes a geometric-analysis route whose stated gap calculation is conditional on quantized Yang-Mills existence and described as at least heuristic.

sources.title: Correlation decay for a U(1) lattice Higgs model
sources.domain: correlation decay in an abelian lattice Higgs model
sources.transfer_boundary: Abelian Higgs correlation decay cannot establish pure nonabelian Yang-Mills, regulator removal, or a Hamiltonian gap.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Use only as a mechanism comparator and explicit target-identity negative control.
reported_claims: The preprint proves exponential correlation decay in a specified small-mass U(1) lattice Higgs regime.

sources.title: Claimed proof of the Yang-Mills mass gap
sources.transfer_boundary: A withdrawn claim supplies no positive theorem evidence and may be used only as a research-quality negative control.
sources.source_to_theory_delta: Retire any use as support; preserve it only to test proof-rhetoric and source-status safeguards.
reported_claims: The withdrawn submission claimed a pure SU(3) construction and mass gap; arXiv states that it was withdrawn for failing research-content quality standards.
